verdict.rationale: Fivetran supports some automatic event-triggered actions — transformations execute automatically after connection syncs or on a schedule, webhooks notify external systems on data events, and alerts fire on sync status changes — but there is no evidence of a general-purpose rule-definition engine for arbitrary custom event→action logic beyond these built-in trigger points. missing for 10: user-definable arbitrary rules/conditions, a broader automation/workflow rule builder, and independent confirmation of this specific capability beyond vendor docs.
